title: Trained 15+ interviewers in Brazil for the global hiring rollout
summary: During the global bar-raiser rollout I trained more than 15 interviewers in the Blumenau, Brazil team and adapted the material for their context.
what_would_have_happened: The Brazil team would have received the India material unchanged.
the_call: Adapt the message to the audience instead of reusing the India deck.
what_i_did: Delivered the session remotely, then shared the recordings and material.
what_changed: Talent acquisition in Amsterdam praised how I adapted the message, and the recordings and material were shared globally.

quotes.text: Also, really appreciated jumping on call with the Blumenau team, how you adapted your message for the audience.
